steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Not every estimate is a yes. Here is what a decline looks like, on both sides.

steps.caption: The client's estimate
steps.narration: First, your client's screen. They have the estimate open.

steps.caption: Decline, beside Approve
steps.narration: Next to the Approve button is Decline.

steps.value: We are going with another bid this time.
steps.caption: A reason
steps.narration: They can say why. The reason is optional.

steps.caption: Estimate declined
steps.narration: The page says the estimate is declined, and that you have been notified.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Now your screen, on the Estimates page.

steps.caption: Status: declined
steps.narration: The estimate's status has changed to declined.

steps.caption: When and why
steps.narration: A red box shows when it was declined, and the reason your client gave.

steps.caption: Edit and resend
steps.narration: A decline is not the end. Edit the estimate, then Resend, to put a new offer in front of them.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Every estimate and its status is under Estimates, in the left menu.

youtube.title: What happens when a client declines an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: See both sides of a declined estimate in the ConstructHUB CRM. The client chooses Decline and can say why; on your side the status changes to declined, with the date and the reason, and you can edit and resend. Recorded in a demo workspace with a made-up client.
